name: @hackefeller/monotone
description: Content pipeline CLI — rewrite, extract, and queue essays

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile bin/monotone.js --target node && node --input-type=commonjs -e "var f=require('fs'),c=f.readFileSync('bin/monotone.js','utf8');f.writeFileSync('bin/monotone.js',c.replace('bun','node'))"
